## Problem

What pain point are you trying to solve?

## Proposed Change

Describe the smallest useful version of the idea.

## Why It Fits Director Angel OS

Explain why this belongs in the Agent OS chassis instead of an app-specific layer.

## Boundary Check

- [ ] this does not require pretending the project already supports a public plugin marketplace
- [ ] this does not require an unbounded self-modifying runtime
- [ ] this does not require turning the repo into a finished vertical agent product

## Alternatives Considered

What else could solve the same problem?

## Verification Idea

How should maintainers know this change is complete?
